name: Lens stand
description: A lens on a stand: a beam passing through it comes out stronger (focused), enough to light a receiver that needs more than a sunbeam. Turns in steps with Interact.

focus.description: Intensity multiplier of a beam that passes through.

stepAngle.description: Degrees one turn rotates the lens.

inputs.name: turn
inputs.description: Interact turns the lens by one step.

outputs.name: lens
outputs.description: The lens entity: a beam through it is multiplied by its focus.
